instruction: I share my spotify premium account with my roommates. I am having trouble logging in. Change its password to @FM[]Jb and share it with them via phone text message.
notes: Because the supervisor cannot log in to Spotify, the password is changed through the reset flow: spotify.send_password_reset_code sends a code to the supervisor's gmail, gmail is logged in with the password from supervisor.show_account_passwords, the reset thread is located with show_inbox_threads and its code read via show_thread, then spotify.reset_password sets the new password. Roommates are discovered with phone.search_contacts(relationship='roommate') (modeled as a single search whose effect unlocks texting any roommate contact); each roommate is texted a message that contains the new password, and texting requires the password change to have already happened. The problem assumes two roommates (matching the 11-call reference length); if the contact search returns a different number, add/remove roommate objects. supervisor-complete-task carries non-API parameters (password and the two roommates, constrained distinct via equality) so its precondition mirrors the goal without hardcoding problem objects in the domain. No answer is passed to complete_task.
